summary: Re-tested Glass Messenger Phase 9C/9D after the two iteration-8 fixes. The backend `_has_perm` fix is verified end-to-end (ban→403, pin→403, invite→200 for an admin holding only can_invite). NewGroupDialog single-step works (no member picker; title-only flow creates and activates the group). However two critical FRONTEND integration miss-wirings make the bulk of Phase 9C/9D unreachable from the UI: (1) Multi-select is unreachable because `ChatPanel.jsx` never passes `selectionMode/isSelected/onToggleSelect/onEnterSelection` props to `<MessageBubble>` — long-press opens the per-message menu instead of selection mode, so the multi-select toolbar can never appear, and Copy/Delete/Forward flows are all blocked. (2) `EditRoleModal` is defined and exported in `GroupDialogs.jsx` but is never imported or rendered anywhere — `setEditRoleFor(m)` runs on click but no JSX consumes the state, so the modal never opens, blocking Phase 9D end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: Multi-select props (selectionMode, isSelected, onToggleSelect, onEnterSelection) are never passed to <MessageBubble>. As a result, long-pressing a bubble opens the message menu (`setMenuOpen(true)`) instead of entering selection mode — the toolbar `data-testid='multi-select-toolbar'` is never rendered. Blocks Copy / Delete-for-everyone / Forward.

EditRoleModal component is exported (line 584) but never imported or instantiated anywhere in the app. Clicking `group-info-edit-role-bob` calls `setEditRoleFor(m)`, but no <EditRoleModal> JSX is rendered using `editRoleFor`. Modal never appears, blocking Phase 9D EditRole flow and admin-title/permissions UI changes.

integration_issues.issue: Toolbar never appears because selection state never reaches MessageBubble. All three Phase 9C item-2 tests are blocked.
EditRoleModal is unreachable; cannot change title or perms via UI; cannot validate `group-sender-admin-title` bubble label updates from the UI side.

action_items: ChatPanel.jsx: when rendering <MessageBubble> (~L548-560) pass `selectionMode={selectionMode}`, `isSelected={selectedIds.includes(m.id)}`, `onEnterSelection={(msg)=>{ setSelectionMode(true); setSelectedIds([msg.id]); }}` and `onToggleSelect={(msg)=>{ setSelectedIds(prev => prev.includes(msg.id) ? prev.filter(x=>x!==msg.id) : [...prev, msg.id]); }}`.

GroupDialogs.jsx (GroupInfoDialog): import/render <EditRoleModal> at the bottom of the dialog: `{editRoleFor && <EditRoleModal member={editRoleFor} kind={conv?.kind || 'group'} onClose={()=>setEditRoleFor(null)} onSave={async (payload)=>{ await api.patch(`/groups/${conv.id}/admins/${editRoleFor.user_id || editRoleFor.id}`, payload); setEditRoleFor(null); refreshMembers?.(); }} />}` — adapt API helper to existing pattern.
After above two wiring fixes, re-run the full Phase 9C/9D playbook (multi-select Copy/Delete/Forward + EditRole end-to-end as alice + bob view title/permission checks).

Persian/RTL smoke + Phase 9C item 1+4 (public-chat search + GroupInfoDialog member count) were not exercised in this iteration because the higher-priority integration bugs block the primary flows; please re-test after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: DEAD CODE: EditRoleModal exported but never used. Either render it or remove the export+state to keep the codebase clean.
MessageBubble accepts selection props in destructuring (iter-8 fix) but ChatPanel doesn't forward them — confirm the two changes were committed together; this looks like a half-merged change.
Backend `_has_perm` correctly defaults to False when an admin_permissions entry exists; legacy admins with no entry still get full perms. This matches the intended semantics. ✓
Suggest unit/E2E coverage gate that asserts `multi-select-toolbar` appears after a synthetic long-press to prevent silent regressions.

rca_of_the_issue: Iteration 8 added selection prop destructuring to MessageBubble.jsx and the toolbar+state to ChatPanel.jsx, but never connected them — `<MessageBubble ... />` is rendered without the new props, so `onEnterSelection` is undefined and long-press falls through to the menu open path. Separately, EditRoleModal was authored and exported but the GroupInfoDialog JSX was never updated to render it conditionally on `editRoleFor`. Both are classic 'wiring missed during refactor' bugs. Reproduction: login alice → open Bob DM → long-press any text bubble → menu opens (toolbar absent). For EditRole: login alice → open P9D Test Group → group info → click 'Edit role' → nothing happens (state mutates silently).
